additional_info.subject: 0402464 - ID0402464-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/RD 300000004027] OCPP Connection lost CRM:00658000855
additional_info.body:
Dear Mert Kanneci,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Saurav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / RD 300000004027
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
CuiPEi
Problem Description
: OCPP offline
Troubleshooting
: Looks like issue from the server side, Internet is connected.
For future reference, your case number is
0402464
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We have analyzed the logs and found that whenever the charger went offline on OCPP, we received
Connection closed because of missing Pong from server.
And we have internet connection at that time.
2025-01-28T06:21:35.300818+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/6ca3e1e1b8b3[737]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - [isMobileConnected] routerIp: 10.20.17.2 connstate: {"stdout":"Connected\n","stderr":""}
2025-01-28T06:21:35.303174+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/6ca3e1e1b8b3[737]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - router is connected via mobile connection, but OCPP is disconected. Restarting PPP interface to reset network setting from mobile provider.
On the backend WebSocketPingInterval is set for 30 sec, that means charger and server will communicate with each other at every 30 sec with Ping and Pong, and if Pong is not received then charger will go offline.
"WebSocketPingInterval": {
"readonly": false,
"value": 30,
"unit": “seconds”
Please check with backend team whether they are experiencing any server issue at their side? And what error code they are receiving at server when charger is going offline on OCPP?
Awaiting your response.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav Kumar

additional_info.body:
Hello Mert,
Thank you for the update.
As we can see that charger is still going offline and online continuously. And charger is coming online agter 30 sec every time.

Issue is still not resolved, and we need input from backend team whether they have anything on their server side.
If we do not receive any input from backend team, then we need to change SIM card on OCPP router with better connectivity to improve this situation.
Let us know if you still want to proceed with closing this case or you want to discuss this with backend team again.
Awaiting your response,
Thank you.
